name: writing-great-system-prompts
short: A Pi skill for writing and auditing system prompts with clear permissions, approval steps and failure handling.
what: One of 19 skills in a collection for the Pi coding agent. It helps you design, review and harden system prompts, agent personas and tool descriptions: who the agent takes instructions from, what needs approval, how it handles failures and untrusted content, and what it must return. It ends with test cases to check a revised prompt against.
who: People who build agents or maintain long-lived system prompts in Pi. It isn't meant for one-off task prompts or AGENTS.md files; other skills in the same collection cover those.
needs: Node.js 18 or later if you want to run the included validator

steps.title: Install the collection for all projects
Check that the skills pass validation

try.label: A first prompt
try.text: /skill:writing-great-system-prompts Review this system prompt for unclear permissions and missing approval steps: [paste your prompt]

watch: The skill turns off automatic use (`disable-model-invocation`), so call it by name.
Cloning installs all 19 skills in the collection.
Several skills include Turkish trigger phrases. The README gives a prompt to strip them if you only work in English.
